citation_requirement.route: GBIF derived dataset for occurrence-search API data
citation_requirement.rationale: The analysis used GBIF occurrence search API records, which do not receive an automatic download DOI. GBIF recommends registering a derived dataset for a citable DOI.

manuscript_insertion.reference_template: GBIF.org. 2026. Filtered export of GBIF occurrence data used for butterfly occurrence validation. GBIF derived dataset. https://doi.org/GBIF_DERIVED_DATASET_DOI_PLACEHOLDER
manuscript_insertion.data_availability_template: The 53,434 GBIF occurrence records used in the occurrence validation are registered as a GBIF derived dataset: https://doi.org/GBIF_DERIVED_DATASET_DOI_PLACEHOLDER.
